limitations: Descriptive diagnostic analysis; n=2 samples per group; no significance tests.
Within-sample percentile ranking uses all 78,932 genes, including zero-count genes, per frozen v1 policy.
Group differences are against a shared two-sample control mean; replicate indices are not matched pairs.
No new gene selection, score optimization, or binding evidence.
Matched background concordance in Phase 4C does not establish sample-level superiority.
Only existing v1 scores are decomposed; no alternative scoring methods tested.
